statements.text: BERT stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers.
GPT stands for General Pretrained Transformer.
statements.correction: GPT stands for Generative Pre-trained Transformer.

statements.text: The Transformer architecture was introduced by Google researchers in the paper "Attention Is All You Need".
Meta created the Llama family of open-weight models.
Gemini models are built by Google DeepMind.
Mistral AI, the company behind Le Chat, is headquartered in Berlin.
statements.correction: Mistral AI is headquartered in Paris.

statements.text: OpenAI's HumanEval benchmark contains 1,640 hand-written programming problems.
statements.correction: HumanEval contains 164 hand-written programming problems.

statements.text: The MMLU benchmark covers 57 subjects, including mathematics, US history, computer science and law.
SWE-bench is built from real GitHub issues in 12 popular Python repositories.
DeepMind's AlphaGo beat Go champion Lee Sedol 4 games to 1.
AlphaFold, the protein structure prediction system, was built by OpenAI.
statements.correction: AlphaFold was built by DeepMind, now Google DeepMind.

statements.text: OpenAI Five beat OG, the reigning Dota 2 world champions.
The JAX numerical computing library was developed by Microsoft Research.
statements.correction: JAX was developed by Google.

statements.text: TensorFlow was developed by the Google Brain team.
PyTorch was originally developed at Facebook AI Research, now part of Meta.
Meta's Llama 3.1 models support a context length of 128K tokens.
The Claude 3 model family launched with a 200K token context window.
Google tested Gemini 1.5 Pro on context windows of up to 100 million tokens in research.
statements.correction: Google tested Gemini 1.5 Pro on up to 10 million tokens in research.

statements.text: Claude Code is Anthropic's agentic coding tool that runs in the terminal.
OpenAI's Codex CLI is an open-source coding agent that runs locally in the terminal.
Google's Gemini CLI is open source under the MIT License.
statements.correction: Gemini CLI is open source under the Apache 2.0 License.

statements.text: Demis Hassabis and John Jumper won a share of the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein structure prediction.
Yoshua Bengio, Geoffrey Hinton and Yann LeCun received the Turing Award for their work on deep learning.
Geoffrey Hinton shared the Nobel Prize in Physics with Yann LeCun.
statements.correction: Hinton shared the Nobel Prize in Physics with John Hopfield.

statements.text: The Qwen family of language models is developed by Alibaba Cloud.
The Kimi K2 model is developed by Moonshot AI.
The GLM family of models is developed by DeepSeek.
statements.correction: The GLM models are developed by Zhipu AI, also known as Z.ai.

statements.text: FlashAttention speeds up attention by cutting reads and writes to GPU memory.
Multi-query attention, where all heads share one set of keys and values, was proposed by Noam Shazeer.
The base Transformer model in "Attention Is All You Need" used 12 attention heads.
statements.correction: The base Transformer model used 8 attention heads.

statements.text: GPT-3 has 175 billion parameters.
BLOOM, the open multilingual model from the BigScience project, has 176 billion parameters.
The largest Llama 3.1 model has 450 billion parameters.
statements.correction: The largest Llama 3.1 model has 405 billion parameters.

statements.text: The Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, for agents to talk to each other, was announced by Google.
Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients and servers exchange JSON-RPC 2.0 messages.
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) was introduced by OpenAI.
statements.correction: MCP was introduced by Anthropic.

statements.text: Libratus, an AI built at Carnegie Mellon University, beat top professional poker players.
DeepMind's AlphaStar reached Grandmaster level in StarCraft II.
IBM's Deep Blue lost its rematch against chess champion Garry Kasparov.
statements.correction: Deep Blue won its rematch against Kasparov.

statements.text: Movie Gen is a set of media generation models from Meta.
Veo is a video generation model from Google DeepMind.
Kling, the AI video generation model, is made by ByteDance.
statements.correction: Kling is made by Kuaishou.

statements.text: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) was introduced in a paper from Facebook AI Research.
Constitutional AI, a method for training AI with a list of principles, was published by Anthropic.
Chain-of-thought prompting was introduced in a paper by Meta AI researchers.
statements.correction: Chain-of-thought prompting was introduced by Google researchers.

statements.text: Humanity's Last Exam was created by the Center for AI Safety and Scale AI.
The GSM8K math benchmark was created by OpenAI.
The MATH benchmark of competition problems was created by OpenAI.
statements.correction: MATH was created by researchers at UC Berkeley.

statements.text: DeepSeek-V3 has 671 billion total parameters, with 37 billion active for each token.
Mixtral 8x7B has 8 experts per layer and sends each token to 2 of them.
Google's Switch Transformer sends each token to 2 experts.
statements.correction: Switch Transformer sends each token to a single expert.

statements.text: Comet is an AI web browser made by Perplexity.
ChatGPT Atlas is a web browser made by OpenAI.
The Dia AI browser is made by Opera.
statements.correction: Dia is made by The Browser Company, the makers of Arc.

statements.text: NVIDIA's Blackwell GPU architecture is named after the mathematician David Blackwell.
Ironwood is Google's seventh-generation TPU.
NVIDIA's H100 GPU is built on the Ampere architecture.
statements.correction: The H100 is built on the Hopper architecture.

statements.text: DeepSeek-R1-Zero was trained with large-scale reinforcement learning, without supervised fine-tuning first.
OpenAI o1 ranked in the 89th percentile on Codeforces competitive programming questions.
OpenAI named its next reasoning model after o1 "o2".
statements.correction: OpenAI skipped the name o2 and named the next model o3.

statements.text: Claude Opus 4.5 scored 80.9% on SWE-bench Verified.
GPT-5 scored 74.9% on SWE-bench Verified.
Gemini 2.5 Pro scored 83.8% on SWE-bench Verified.
statements.correction: At launch, Gemini 2.5 Pro scored 63.8% on SWE-bench Verified with a custom agent.

statements.text: OpenAI's gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b open-weight models use the Apache 2.0 license.
Mistral 7B was released under the Apache 2.0 license.
Meta released Llama 2 under the Apache 2.0 license.
statements.correction: Llama 2 uses Meta's own Llama 2 Community License.

statements.text: Word2vec was introduced by researchers at Google.
ResNet, the deep residual network for image recognition, came from Microsoft Research.
Generative adversarial networks (GANs) were introduced by researchers at OpenAI.
statements.correction: GANs were introduced by Ian Goodfellow and others at the Université de Montréal.

statements.text: wav2vec 2.0, a model that learns speech from raw audio, was developed by Facebook AI.
Meta's SeamlessM4T is a single model for speech and text translation in up to 100 languages.
OpenAI trained the original Whisper model on 68,000 hours of audio.
statements.correction: The original Whisper was trained on 680,000 hours of audio.

statements.text: vLLM was first developed in the Sky Computing Lab at UC Berkeley.
GGUF, a file format for model weights, was created by the developer of llama.cpp.
The safetensors format for storing model weights was created by Google.
statements.correction: safetensors was created by Hugging Face.

statements.text: Google DeepMind's AlphaProof proves math statements in the formal language Lean.
An advanced version of Gemini Deep Think reached gold-medal level at the International Mathematical Olympiad.
Google DeepMind's AlphaProof and AlphaGeometry 2 reached gold-medal level at the International Mathematical Olympiad.
statements.correction: AlphaProof and AlphaGeometry 2 reached silver-medal level, solving four of six problems.

statements.text: Anthropic's Claude 3 family had three models: Haiku, Sonnet and Opus.
Google's first Gemini model came in three sizes: Ultra, Pro and Nano.
OpenAI's GPT-4o family has three models: GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini and GPT-4o nano.
statements.correction: There is no GPT-4o nano. OpenAI's first nano model was GPT-4.1 nano.

statements.text: Meta pretrained Llama 3 on over 15 trillion tokens.
The Pile, an open dataset from EleutherAI, is 825 GiB of English text.
Hugging Face's FineWeb dataset has about 150 trillion tokens.
statements.correction: FineWeb launched with about 15 trillion tokens and has since grown to about 18.5 trillion.

statements.text: GitHub Copilot was first powered by OpenAI Codex.
Junie is the AI coding agent made by JetBrains.
Amazon's agentic coding IDE is called Jules.
statements.correction: Amazon's agentic IDE is Kiro. Jules is Google's coding agent.

statements.text: The Vision Transformer paper is titled "An Image is Worth 16x16 Words".
OpenAI trained CLIP on 400 million image and text pairs.
Meta's SA-1B dataset for Segment Anything has 11 million masks.
statements.correction: SA-1B has over 1 billion masks on 11 million images.

statements.text: The ARC-AGI benchmark was created by François Chollet.
A preview of OpenAI's o3 scored 75.7% on the ARC-AGI-1 Semi-Private set in its high-efficiency setting.
ARC-AGI-1 puzzles use grids of up to 50x50 cells.
statements.correction: ARC-AGI-1 grids are at most 30x30 cells.

statements.text: In OpenAI's InstructGPT paper, people preferred a 1.3B model's outputs over the 175B GPT-3.
LoRA can cut the number of trainable parameters by 10,000 times compared with full fine-tuning of GPT-3.
DeepMind's compute-optimal Chinchilla model has 280 billion parameters.
statements.correction: Chinchilla has 70 billion parameters. Gopher is the 280B model.

statements.text: Microsoft's Phi-3-mini has 3.8 billion parameters.
Google's Gemma 2 comes in 2B, 9B and 27B sizes.
Apple's on-device foundation model has about 30 billion parameters.
statements.correction: Apple's on-device model has about 3 billion parameters.

statements.text: Claude 3.5 Sonnet was the first frontier AI model to offer computer use in public beta.
OpenAI's Operator agent was powered by a model called Computer-Using Agent (CUA).
Project Mariner, a research prototype agent that works in the browser, is from Microsoft.
statements.correction: Project Mariner is from Google DeepMind.

statements.text: GPQA has 448 multiple-choice questions written by experts in biology, physics and chemistry.
The MATH benchmark has 12,500 competition mathematics problems.
GSM8K has 85,000 grade school math word problems.
statements.correction: GSM8K has 8,500 grade school math word problems.
